title: Abba bar Abba bar Mamal
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him once (פ״א, פעם אחת) in Pe’ah, chapter 8, halakhah 8, where he put a question to R' La (Ila).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source itself repeats “once” as both abbreviation פ״א and the words פעם אחת.

The complete Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8 section, fifteen whole paragraphs, was read without a matching Abba bar Abba bar Mamal question to La/Ila. This is a bounded nonmatch, not absence elsewhere or a correction of Hyman’s locator. The new body attributes the mention to Hyman and retains R' La (Ila), the repeated once wording, and all three names in the heading. The current note is unchanged; no teacher, identity, or genealogy is admitted.
